def transform(grid):
    import copy
    g=[r[:] for r in grid]; h=len(g); w=len(g[0])
    walls={(r,c) for r in range(h) for c in range(w) if g[r][c]==2}
    center=[(r,c) for r in range(h) for c in range(w) if g[r][c]==3][0]
    out=[row[:] for row in g]
    dirs=[(-1,0),(0,1),(1,0),(0,-1)]
    r,c=center; out[r][c]=3
    L=2; d=0; drawn=0
    for arm in range(80):
        dr,dc=dirs[d%4]; blocked=False; drew=False

        if arm%2==1: L+=2
        if blocked: continue

    for (r,c) in walls: out[r][c]=2
    return out
